🎓 A Step Forward in My Legal Journey! ⚖️

I’m happy to share that I have successfully completed my internship at Shriji Legal Associate under the guidance of Advocate Sudhir Kumar Srivastava.

During this internship, I had the opportunity to gain practical exposure to various aspects of legal practice, including attending civil and criminal courts, consumer forums, participating in case preparation, and conducting legal research.

This experience has helped me strengthen my understanding of legal concepts and given me valuable insights into the practical workings of the legal profession. I’m grateful for the guidance, learning, and experience I received throughout this journey.

Looking forward to applying these learnings and continuing to grow as a law student. 📚⚖️
